name: Bonusly
summary: Bonusly lists Team at $3 per user a month, or $5 with the Bizy assistant. The Organization plan has no published price. Rewards are paid at face value when employees redeem them. Company-wide analytics and SAML SSO are on the Organization plan only.

facts.text: The pricing page says employees redeem rewards from the Bonusly catalog, and the employer pays face value when a reward is redeemed.
Company-wide analytics, recognition quality reporting and SAML SSO are listed under the Organization plan, which has no published price.
The pricing page offers a monthly billing toggle, while an FAQ on the same page says all plans are billed annually. The page does not resolve the conflict.
The Bizy add-on costs $2 per user a month. The page also says Bizy is included in the Team and Organization plans, so the terms are unclear.

plans.name: Team + Bizy
plans.notes: Monthly toggle price. The page lists $50 per user a year on annual billing. The page does not name a currency

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Monthly toggle price. The page lists $30 per user a year on annual billing

plans.name: Organization + Bizy
plans.notes: Custom pricing on request through a demo

hiddenCosts: The page contradicts itself on billing, offering a monthly toggle while an FAQ says all plans are billed annually. Confirm terms with the vendor.
Reward redemptions are paid at face value on top of the subscription.
Analytics, nominations, spot bonuses and SAML SSO require the Organization plan.
